title: Typewriter and Lantern
author: Isandro Eriksen
blurb: Gideon Okafor, a widowed lighthouse keeper during the year of the great storms, keeps a low profile and busy hands. Then a stranger arrives carrying unmistakable handwriting from a supposed corpse — and he is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now he must get the truth on the record ahead of the victors' historians, and time is already running out.
style: atmospheric and lyrical, with strong sensory detail
